sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.status: Final territorial estimates, source/end-user/SIC data and revision history
sources.verified_fact: The publication supplies final UK territorial estimates from 1990, states that all years were revised for methodological improvements and new data, and added 2024 SIC outputs on 25 June 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an explicit revision-control surface for national and SIC control totals; it does not identify parcel emissions.

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas
sources.status: CO2, CH4, N2O, HFC, PFC, SF6, NF3 and total GHG by approximately 130 SIC groups, 1990-2024
sources.verified_fact: The current 8.9 MB edition covers 1990-2024 and records that an earlier 2023 CO2 error affecting specified industries was corrected on 2 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds residence-based industry/gas reconciliation and an explicit correction-history gate; territorial and parcel measures remain separate.
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.

sources.title: UK Environmental Accounts: 2026
sources.status: Residence-based GHG and energy-use overview with quality, methods and source notes
sources.verified_fact: The bulletin reports 478 MtCO2e on a residence basis for 2024 and explicitly defines the measure as including UK residents and registered businesses wherever emissions occur.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a scope-control check that prevents residence-based totals from being substituted for territorial, facility or parcel values.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: GOV.UK activity-based conversion factors, flat file and methodology
sources.status: 2026 Scope 1, 2 and 3 reporting factors with full, flat-file, methodology and major-change documents
sources.verified_fact: The factors calculate emissions from activity data such as fuel volume, purchased electricity and travel distance and are updated annually with methodology and change reports.
sources.quality_effect: Adds conversion-method validation for future activity data; factors alone are not observed site or parcel emissions.

sources.title: UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory, 1990 to 2024
sources.surface: Official National Inventory Document and annex package
sources.status: UNFCCC inventory report with annexes, energy background data, consistency files and CRT outputs
sources.verified_fact: The report package includes the 1990-2024 inventory, annexes, fuel reconciliation, consistency annexes and 2026 UNFCCC and Paris Agreement CRT outputs.
sources.quality_effect: Adds primary inventory-method and reconciliation evidence for national consistency checks.

sources.title: Emissions Factors Data Selector
sources.status: UK-specific GHG factors available from 1990 with source, fuel, category and sector selectors
sources.verified_fact: The selector covers UK greenhouse-gas factors from 1990 and warns that missing factors may reflect a non-factor methodology or confidential data.
sources.quality_effect: Adds factor-level plausibility checks while preventing missing factors from being interpreted as zero.

sources.title: Devolved Government Greenhouse Gas Emissions
sources.surface: Official England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland inventory catalogue
sources.status: Latest 1990-2024 source/end-user inventories and traded/non-traded comparison
sources.verified_fact: The latest catalogue links the 1990-2024 devolved inventories, explains source and end-user bases, and compares each administration with reported EU ETS and UK ETS site emissions.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an England-level territorial control and ETS comparison without supplying parcel measurements.
